city.name: Grayspine
city.tagline: A sealed city held together by power theft, private armies, and failing systems.
city.summary: Grayspine is a vertical megacity in decline. Its towers remain lit, but its authority is fractured among hostile powers fighting over the city's buried control systems.
city.key_objective: Reach the Spine Core before one faction secures permanent control.
flavor_lines: Every light in the skyline is powered by a lie.

factions.name: Helix Ward
factions.territory: Underground labs, sewer vaults, hidden clinics
factions.goal: Remake the population into something the city can sustain
factions.combat_style: Infection, mutation thresholds, healing loops, and ugly support chains.
factions.slogan: They do not heal the city. They rewrite it.

factions.name: Blackwire Directorate
factions.goal: Restore control through force, automation, and compliance
factions.combat_style: Target marking, buff denial, disciplined formations, and automated support.
factions.slogan: Order, purchased at gunpoint and maintained by code.

factions.name: Cinder Jackals
factions.theme: Raiders, scrap warfare, and desert brutality
factions.territory: Refinery ruins, edge camps, canyon roads
factions.goal: Strip the city and survive its death on their terms
factions.combat_style: Swarm pressure, momentum, dirty ranged threats, and reckless bruisers.
factions.slogan: If the city must die, they want front row seats.

spine_core.name: Spine Core
spine_core.summary: A buried civic-control lattice that once coordinated the city's critical systems.
spine_core.importance: Whoever controls it can shape what Grayspine becomes next.
spine_core.locked_summary: The buried machine that remembers how the city used to obey.
spine_core.unlocked_summary: The Spine Core still routes power, transit permissions, lockdown authority, and survival systems under the city.
